about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Dina Titus

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WATER RESOURCES DEVELOPMENT ACT OF 2026
statements.title: WATER RESOURCES DEVELOPMENT ACT OF 2026
sentences: It directs the Army Corps to consider the impact of data centers, a growing issue in this country, on water supply and conservation projects.

This is especially important in the Southwest because if you look at the plans for these data centers, about two-thirds of those on the books coming up are slated to be built in regions that are experiencing drought.
I urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING THE INTERNATIONAL DAY AGAINST NUCLEAR TESTS AND KAZAKHSTAN'S ENDURING CONTRIBUTION TO GLOBAL SECURITY
statements.title: COMMEMORATING THE INTERNATIONAL DAY AGAINST NUCLEAR TESTS AND KAZAKHSTAN'S ENDURING CONTRIBUTION TO GLOBAL SECURITY
sentences: It hosted two rounds of P5+1 negotiations with Iran in 2013 which led to the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, supported implementation of the 2015 nuclear agreement, and now hosts the IAEA Low Enriched Uranium Bank at the Ulba Metallurgical Plant.
I also urge Congress to repeal the Jackson-Vanik amendment and establish permanent normal trade relations with Kazakhstan.
I urge the Senate to ratify the Protocol to the Central Asian Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone Treaty, which the United States signed in 2014.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF THE BILL (H.R. 2913) TO AUTHORIZE SUPPORT FOR UKRAINE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF THE BILL (H.R. 2913) TO AUTHORIZE SUPPORT FOR UKRAINE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
sentences: Had I been present, I would have voted YEA on Roll Call No. 206, on agreeing to the resolution providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2913) to authorize support for Ukraine, and for other purposes. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: Forty States, three territories, and the District of Columbia allow medical use of cannabis products, but not something for our veterans who live and work in those places.
For the nearly 200,000 veterans who call Nevada home, this commonsense amendment would allow healthcare professionals at the VA to just discuss cannabis for medical purposes with their patients.
It would also assist them in filling out any forms that might be required by the State to qualify for medical marijuana assistance.
Cannabis has proven to help with a wide variety of medical issues that veterans face, including pain management, PTSD, and opioid addiction.
Mr. Chair, I urge all my colleagues to vote in favor of this amendment because it will be a meaningful step in the right direction for our veterans and for cannabis reform.
Mr. Chair, I rise in opposition to the amendment, although I am not opposed to it.
Mr. Chair, I proudly support this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMBATING ORGANIZED RETAIL CRIME ACT OF 2025
statements.title: COMBATING ORGANIZED RETAIL CRIME ACT OF 2025
sentences: Organized retail crime is one of the most pressing concerns I hear about from businesses, workers, law enforcement, and community leaders, not just in Nevada, but across the country.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 2853, the Combating Organized Retail Crime Act legislation, which I am proud to co-lead and have been working on since 2021 with then-Representative Buck.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP RENEGED ON CAMPAIGN PROMISES
statements.title: TRUMP RENEGED ON CAMPAIGN PROMISES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, we are seeing in real time how global instability can come home to hit our working families.
President Trump's war of choice in Iran is not just a foreign policy blunder, but it is also exacerbating the Trump slump.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4626, DON'T MESS WITH MY HOME APPLIANCES ACT, AND PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4758, HOMEOWNER ENERGY FREEDOM ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4626, DON'T MESS WITH MY HOME APPLIANCES ACT, AND PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4758, HOMEOWNER ENERGY FREEDOM ACT
sentences: Had I been present, I would have voted YEA on Roll Call No. 71, H.R. 6329, YEA on Roll Call No. 72, S. 2503, NAY on Roll Call No. 73, the previous question on H. Res. 1075, and NAY on Roll Call No. 74, adoption of H. Res. 1075. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT AND NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT AND NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: By eliminating NED's appropriation, U.S.-based nonprofit organizations, local partners, and frontline democracy defenders in dangerous contexts will be put in immediate jeopardy, undermining efforts to support emerging democracies and those resisting authoritarian rule like the brave protesters in Iran.
In places like Nicaragua, Venezuela, Cuba, North Korea, Hong Kong, Tibet, Burma and, as I mentioned, Iran, NED provides vital resources for those advocating for freedom.

Mr. Chairman, I rise in strong opposition to a narrow- minded, shortsighted amendment that is going to be offered to this bill on the National Endowment for Democracy, prohibiting funding for that important organization.
Mr. Chairman, I urge all of my colleagues to reject this terrible amendment when it comes up and show the rest of the world we have not lost our minds nor lost our way.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPIRATION OF NEW START
statements.title: EXPIRATION OF NEW START
sentences: A lot of testing is right in our own backyard.
The last time a nuke was tested was 2017 by North Korea.
For these reasons, I introduced the RESTRAIN Act to prohibit the resumption of explosive nuclear testing and prevent any funds from going toward Trump's misguided policy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TIPPED EMPLOYEE PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: TIPPED EMPLOYEE PROTECTION ACT
sentences: With the power of organized labor, casino workers, servers, line cooks, housekeepers, and others put Las Vegas on the map as a world-renowned hospitality center.
It would raise the minimum wage and all subminimum wages to $17 an hour over the next 3 years with annual increases after that.
That is why I introduced the LIFT Act last year.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SLOAN CANYON CONSERVATION AND LATERAL PIPELINE ACT
statements.title: SLOAN CANYON CONSERVATION AND LATERAL PIPELINE ACT
sentences: As we barrel toward record low water projections at Lake Mead and the increasing risk of prolonged drought due to climate change, there is no time to waste in securing water reliability for southern Nevadans.
Mr. Speaker, I thank you for your attention to this, and I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' today on this critical legislation for southern Nevada's water future.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT AMERICA'S WORKFORCE ACT
statements.title: PROTECT AMERICA'S WORKFORCE ACT
sentences: Since day one, President Trump has worked to dismantle the institutions that protect workers and weaken the power of organized labor.
He dismissed commissioners from the Federal agency responsible for enforcing workforce civil rights, and he stripped the National Labor Relations Board of its quorum.
That is why I am a strong supporter of this legislation that will overturn the President's dangerous and illegal executive order eliminating collective bargaining.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to do the same and vote in favor of this important legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OPPOSITION TO EXPLOSIVE NUCLEAR TESTING
statements.title: OPPOSITION TO EXPLOSIVE NUCLEAR TESTING
sentences: In fact, Vladimir Putin has already directed his forces to prepare a resumption of nuclear testing and, just this week, the Washington Post reported that China is rapidly expanding and modernizing infrastructure at its nuclear testing site in the Xinjiang Province.

If a nuclear power resumes testing because the U.S. is abandoning the testing moratorium, those countries will develop new types of warheads and close the scientific and technical advantage we have always enjoyed in warhead design.
Not even North Korea opposed it.
That's why I introduced the PRESUME Act which would ensure radiation-exposed veterans receive their rightful benefits from the VA.
For these reasons, I introduced the RESTRAIN Act to prohibit the resumption of explosive nuclear testing and prevent any funds from going toward Trump's misguided policy.
I urge all of my colleagues to join me and cosponsor my RESTRAIN Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NUCLEAR TESTING OPPOSITION
statements.title: NUCLEAR TESTING OPPOSITION
sentences: In fact, we have already seen that Putin has directed his forces to prepare to resume nuclear testing.
You know, not even North Korea voted ``no'' on this provision, so what kind of signal does that send?

That is why earlier this year, I introduced the PRESUME Act, which would ensure that radiation-exposed veterans who had been exposed to this radiation would receive their rightful benefits from the VA.
For these reasons, I have introduced the Renewing Efforts to Suspend Testing and Reinforce Arms Control Initiative Now, the RESTRAIN Act.
I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting this and getting this passed before we begin another arms race. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WELCOMING HIS ALL-HOLINESS BARTHOLOMEW I, ECUMENICAL PATRIARCH OF CONSTANTINOPLE
statements.title: WELCOMING HIS ALL-HOLINESS BARTHOLOMEW I, ECUMENICAL PATRIARCH OF CONSTANTINOPLE
sentences: While the police ``stood idly by or cheered on the mob,'' according to a report of the U.S. consul, 4,000 Greek shops and 2,000 homes were sacked and plundered, 38 churches were burned to the ground and 35 more desecrated, and 52 schools were destroyed.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MARKING THE 15TH ANNUAL INTERNATIONAL DAY AGAINST NUCLEAR TESTS
statements.title: MARKING THE 15TH ANNUAL INTERNATIONAL DAY AGAINST NUCLEAR TESTS
sentences: With thousands of nuclear-armed ICBMs in places like Belarus and Ukraine, the newly- formed Republic of Kazakhstan inherited the world's fourth-largest nuclear arsenal, which was also home of the Semipalatinsk nuclear test site.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BRINGING FAIRNESS BACK TO GAMING TAXATION
statements.title: BRINGING FAIRNESS BACK TO GAMING TAXATION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge everyone to bet on the come, and pass the FAIR BET Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DO NOT SELL OFF PUBLIC LANDS
statements.title: DO NOT SELL OFF PUBLIC LANDS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to send a message to Senator Lee and his allies: We are not going to let you use our treasured public lands as revenue raisers to pay for tax cuts for billionaires.
It is not in the bill right now, but the fight is far from over, and so we will continue to do that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: They can see my Republican colleagues cutting benefits for families while cutting taxes for billionaires.
They can see my friends on the other side of the aisle stripping funds from renewable energy, Medicaid, and public education.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTRACT FOR AMERICA
statements.title: CONTRACT FOR AMERICA
sentences: I propose a Contract for America, one that reflects who we are as Democrats: Good wages, fair taxes, quality education, protecting Social Security and Medicare, expanding veterans' benefits, providing universal healthcare, environmental conservation, and national security.
We need a message that spells out exactly what we will do to benefit our constituents and how we will do it.
